It uses essentially the same three-recital structure: an agreement transferring TVA interests to Agriculture so lands may be incorporated into national forests, presidential approval of that agreement, and a finding that the lands are suitable for national-forest purposes and inclusion is in the public interest. Both then proceed under “NOW, THEREFORE” to headings and detailed metes-and-bounds descriptions of TVA-associated lands. C24 closely parallels the same machinery but is less textually and factually proximate; C04 shares TVA-style land-description conventions but not the displayed forest-inclusion
